sourceOrder: Provider-ranked matched players retain source order. Unranked forecasted players follow by corrected category rank. Unmatched provider rows and identities with neither provider rank nor forecast remain review-only and are excluded from imports and rehearsals.

fresh-rotowire-public10.scope: ten-public-projection-rows-only; per-game numeric display; GP season count

limitations: No projected or modeled statistics are included.
Stale ranks stay ordered as observed and carry a stale rank freshness flag; no current provider rank was inferred.
Unmatched identities and available-pool identities with neither provider rank nor forecast are review-only and excluded from proposed imports and rehearsals.
